parts.text:
The X button calls `el-dialog`'s `handleClose` (→ emits `update:visible=false`). The close logic itself is sound; the only thing that can intercept a header `mousedown`/click is the `v-dialogDrag` directive we added in the regression commit. `zs-dialog` uses the same directive and closes fine because its `visible` is a plain data prop, whereas `ImageViewer` couples `:visible.sync` to a store-backed computed — but more importantly this is the textbook "drag directive swallows the close-button click" regression. The canonical, safe fix is to stop the drag from starting on the close button.
